messages:
arjun (sre): Heads up — sudden spike in queued requests to hosted us-west-2 gateway, admission windows collapsed across multiple pools. Seeing 5xx + long tail latencies.
marisa (runtime): Confirmed. KV cache hit rates dropped, lots of cold prefixes. Fallback routing started hitting smaller pools.
chris (oncall): Alert graph: hosted-api 5xx rate from 0.3% -> 4.2% in 90s. Error mix 502/504 + connection resets.
arjun (sre): @marisa can you paste the admission logs for the controller?
marisa (runtime): Paste logs: ```[2025-11-03T14:12:21Z] admission_controller: window=0 active=0 pending=4823 backpressure=tripped -> route:fallback_pool_1
[2025-11-03T14:12:22Z] admission_controller: open_window -> closed due to capacity_delta=-0.95
[2025-11-03T14:12:23Z] routing: fallback decided for 70% of new requests```
leo (infra): Network metrics show burst from batch-processor jobs in same AZ. We had an autoscaler glitch so new GPU nodes didn't come up in time.
olivia (platform): That autoscaler job was paused (manual) for the maintenance window, I forgot to re-enable it. cc @chris
chris (oncall): Oof. So two things: admission windows close, many requests get rerouted -> small pools overloaded -> they hit their admission limits and then generate another wave of fallbacks = thundering herd.
arjun (sre): Exactly. It's a feedback loop: admission->fallback->small pool overload->admission->more fallback. Backpressure never stabilized.
marisa (runtime): Temporary mitigation applied: set global ingress throttling to 60rps per-tenant, disabled fallback routing to the smallest pools, and forced a progressive reroute to regional standby pools.
deploy-bot: deploy v2025.11.03-hotfix-adm rolled out to controller (replicas 3 -> 5) by marisa.
marisa (runtime): Rolling increase of admission_controller replicas and bumped window size by +20% to reduce oscillation. Also tuned KV cache TTLs to favor hot prefixes.
leo (infra): Brought 8 GPU nodes online in us-west-2 manually. Verified node health and label sync.
chris (oncall): Post-mitigation: 5xx back to 0.6% in ~7 minutes. Average p95 latency from 1.2s down to 420ms.
arjun (sre): Impact: hosted API degraded for ~12 minutes. Approx 18k requests timed out/fell back; 3 customer incidents reported. No data loss.
olivia (platform): Root causes: 1) Autoscaler left paused during maintenance, 2) admission controller default config was too aggressive under rapid load, 3) fallback routing decision favored small regional pools without capacity checks.
marisa (runtime): Contributing factors: 1) KV cache cold start collapse amplifies token generation cost, 2) lack of circuit-breaker for fallback routing decisions, 3) alerting thresholds for admission oscillation were too lax.
arjun (sre): Timeline quick: 14:12:20 spike begins -> 14:13:10 admission windows collapse -> 14:13:40 fallback thrash -> 14:20:00 mitigation controls active -> 14:24:00 stable.
chris (oncall): Immediate action items (done): - Re-enable autoscaler & validate runbooks (olivia) - Disable fallback to tiny pools (marisa) - Emergency scale of controller & nodes (leo)
olivia (platform): Follow-ups (todo): - Add pre-check in routing to ensure target pool has >= X capacity before routing a fallback - Add autoscaler post-maintenance checklist (owner: olivia) - Add synthetic load test for admission oscillation (owner: marisa)
marisa (runtime): Engineering tasks (prio): - Implement circuit-breaker for fallback routing (2w) - Smooth admission window adjustments (1w) - Improve KV cache warmup on pool scale events (1w)
arjun (sre): Alerts / monitoring changes: - New alert: admission-oscillation-rate > 0.5% for 2m (owner: arjun) - Dashboard: queued-pending by pool (owner: leo) - Add chart for fallback-volume per pool (owner: marisa)
chris (oncall): Postmortem draft will be posted to #postmortems by tomorrow EOD. We'll include timeline, RCA, mitigation, and customer comms notes.
olivia (platform): Lessons: don't rely on tiny capacity pools as fallbacks; fallback policy must be capacity-aware.
marisa (runtime): Also add a test to simulate autoscaler disabled during maintenance to observe admission behavior in staging.
arjun (sre): Anything else urgent?
leo (infra): I'll run a capacity audit across regions and tag pools with effective headroom. ETA 3 days.
chris (oncall): Thanks all. Marking incident as resolved for now, leave thread open for postmortem comments. :thumbsup:
